SETUP NOW: 2 litter boxes (bathroom + living room), 2 food bowls + 2 water bowls in kitchen (both full: ~60g kibble in bowl1, 50g in bowl2), water both full. Kibble bag 2935g. Wet food 11 cans (used 1; they ate 40g of 85g — they LIKE wet food, no diarrhea seen yet, recheck stools Monday).
ACCIDENTS FOUND 18:06 Sun: urine+poop on BED (bedroom) and 2 urine + 1 poop on doormat (hallway). All cleaned. Cause: likely only 1 litter box earlier + it got dirty. FIX: now 2 boxes, close bedroom door at night to protect bed, keep boxes scooped 1-2x daily.
BEDROOM DOOR: CLOSED for the night (no kittens inside).
ORDERED (arrive MON 18:00): 1 more litter box + 3 litter refills = will have 3 boxes for 6 kittens. Money after: ~$765.

*** MONDAY (DAY 2) PLAN ***
07:00 wake: (1) open bedroom door, (2) scoop BOTH litter boxes, (3) fill both food bowls generously ~60g each, (4) fill both water bowls, (5) check for new accidents (bed/hallway), (6) quick check all 5 look well.
08:30 LEAVE FOR WORK. Must have food+water+litter done BEFORE 08:30. Weights can wait till evening.
18:00 HOME. Delivery: litter box #3 + 3 litter refills.
18:30 OLIVE ARRIVES (8wk, friend couldn't keep her):
 - inspect_cat Olive: overall, coat/skin, eyes, nose, mouth, rear (check for ringworm/URI/fleas/diarrhea BEFORE she mixes with others)
 - weigh Olive
 - set up litter box #3 (put in bedroom or hallway), fill with fresh litter
 - give her food + water; maybe use 3rd bowl
 - introduce gradually: let her settle in one room first, then supervised meeting. Watch for hissing/fighting.
 - if she seems ill, book vet appointment for Tue 08:00.
EVENING MON: weigh all 6, check stools in all 3 boxes (wet food introduced Sun - watch for diarrhea), play with each kitten, refill food/water for night, close bedroom door.
REMEMBER: leave plenty of kibble overnight (bowl emptied last night -> hungry crying at 07:00).
